PREFIX agents: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX eli-dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>

PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?member ?name ?sourceId WHERE {
  GRAPH ?memberGraph { ?member a agents:Member ; foaf:name ?name . OPTIONAL { ?member agents:pId ?sourceId . } }
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?memberGraph), "https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/member/"))
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), LCASE(STR("Malcolm Byrne"))) ||
         LCASE(STR(?sourceId)) = LCASE(STR("MalcolmByrne")))
} ORDER BY ?member ?name LIMIT 100

PREFIX agents: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX eli-dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX members: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?member ?name WHERE {
  GRAPH ?memberGraph { ?member a agents:Member ; foaf:name ?name . }

  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), LCASE(STR("Mary Lou McDonald"))))
} LIMIT 100
